name: Coffee liqueur
definition: liqueur flavoured mainly with coffee.
notes: Tia Maria Cold Brew Coffee Liqueur: sweet liqueur with strong coffee character, sold as coffee liqueur.

name: Fruit cider
definition: apple cider fermented or flavoured with other fruit (berry, cherry, citrus and the like).
notes: Kopparberg Mixed Fruit: apple cider with raspberry and blackcurrant; sold as fruit cider.

name: Other sparkling wine
definition: sparkling wine outside the Champagne, Cava, Prosecco and Crémant kinds (Sekt, Lambrusco, Asti and others are its named forms).
notes: Sekt collection beside Champagne, Cava, Prosecco, Crémant; Lambrusco listed as red sparkling wine.

name: Ice wine
definition: sweet wine pressed from grapes frozen on the vine (Eiswein, Icewine).
notes: Riesling Eiswein made from grapes harvested frozen on the vine, sold under the name Eiswein.

name: Dried-grape wine [passito]
definition: sweet wine made from grapes dried after picking (passito, vin santo, straw wine).
notes: Passito wines category, 95 items; sweet wines from dried grapes (Passito di Pantelleria, Vin Santo).

name: Other fortified wine
definition: wine fortified with spirit outside the Port, Sherry and Madeira kinds (vin doux naturel, Marsala, Rutherglen Muscat and others).
notes: Marsala collection of Sicilian fortified wine (Pellegrino, Florio) sold apart from Port, Sherry, Madeira.

name: Merlot
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Merlot grape.
notes: Red Wine page facet Merlot 91 items.

name: Malbec
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Malbec grape.
notes: Red Wine page facet Malbec 109 items.

name: Zinfandel/Primitivo
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Zinfandel grape, under either name.
notes: Red Wine page facet Zinfandel 143 items; Primitivo not shown as facet.

name: Tempranillo
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Tempranillo grape.
notes: Red Wine page facet Tempranillo 179 items; Bodegas Vatan Tinta de Toro listed.

name: Grenache/Garnacha
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Grenache grape, under either name.
notes: Red Wine page facet Grenache 84 items.

name: Other red blend
definition: still red wine blended from several grapes outside the Bordeaux blend (Rhône, Tuscan and other red blends).
notes: Red Wine page facets Other Red Blends 474, Rhône Blends 284, Tuscan Blends 73.

name: Riesling
definition: still white wine made mainly from the Riesling grape.
notes: White Wine page facet Riesling 337 items.

name: Chenin Blanc
definition: still white wine made mainly from the Chenin Blanc grape.
notes: White Wine page facet Chenin Blanc 100 items.

name: Gewürztraminer
definition: still white wine made mainly from the Gewürztraminer grape.
notes: White Wine page facet Gewurztraminer 31 items.

name: White blend
definition: still white wine blended from several grapes, such as white Bordeaux of Sauvignon Blanc and Sémillon.
notes: White Wine page facets Other White Blends 244, Bordeaux White Blends 102.

name: Non-designated sake [futsūshu]
definition: ordinary sake outside the eight special designations.
notes: Tozai Typhoon described as Futsu grade table sake; Wine.com has a futsushu category.

name: Cheongju
definition: Korean clear refined rice wine.
notes: Yangchon Premium Korean Cheongju 500mL, refined rice wine, sold in Sake category; Seosul chungju also sold.

name: Blended grain whisky
definition: blend of single grain whiskies from more than one distillery.
notes: Compass Box Hedonism described as blended grain whisky; 2025 release on sale.

name: Mixed spirits
definition: mixed pack of spirits of several kinds, none of which makes up half or more of its volume or weight.
notes: Boxed tasting set of whisky, rum and vodka 5cl miniatures, one third each.
